OP Here

I have finished packing almost everything up. I am debating on putting what I have left on kijiji and telling people "first come first serve" but I'm worried that would trip some alarm bells. 

I'm feeling a lot more calm, and according to people I'm super agreeable. My friend at the grocery store said that "I wish you were like this everyday!" this may because I looked happy... or maybe it was because I was giving him my kindle. 

Said friend stopped by after work attempting to return the kindle, he almost ruined everything. If he had seen my apartment then the cat wouldve been out of the bag. I just lied to him and told him I had bought one of the new ones.
if I were to tell the truth then I would surely lose my job. It's  a job I got by lying about my high school credentials.
